notes: Rumble Arena's Korean name is 와글와글 아레나 (shorthand 와레나); TW 熱鬧開戰競技場; JP わちゃわちゃアリーナ (hashtag on けふぁ video).

Cookie identities in formation screenshots were read from portraits, cross-checked against Seo Sinwoo's damage tables (which print names) and the posts' own text rosters. Portrait mapping used: pink round hat=마카롱, dark purple coat=피노누아, red frills=석류, nurse+pink bear=우유, white blob robot=이온, green leaf hair=허브, golden fluffy=치즈케이크, white fox with blue blade=바리공주, small white/red beast=이름 모를 케이크 들개, dark-red hair eyepatch=체리콜라, blonde bunny/persimmon girl=감감술래 달토끼, feathered hat=호밀, white hair red greatsword=오븐방랑자, purple witch with grapes=포도넝쿨, pink star-cream hair=딸기크레페, yellow dancer blue tutu=피겨여왕, crowned yellow bear=도넛킹, pink goggles=브라이트시커.

Pet icons: yellow jelly (20)=갓난갓방울 (ATK +20%), brown chocolate drop=근엄한 초코왕방울 (max HP +20%), hotdog=핫도그도그 (Skill AMP), white bird=얼음과자새 (DMG reduction), pink card with green star=전지멜로우 (Rapid Fire synergy +2, Rapid Fire receivers ATK +10%). Effects read from in-game pet screen in VART lkvjzy8JgyQ and Seo Sinwoo _D4EvaRYdJY.

Star levels written as '~N' are inferred from the number of unlocked sugar-rune slots on screen (slots unlock at 1/2/4/6★ one each, 8★ two, 10★ two, per guide 43444) and the '★N 승급 시' locked-slot labels, not read from star icons.

In PvP posts 바궁 = 바람궁수 (Wind Archer), not 바리공주. 바리 / 바공 / 바리공듀 = Princess Bari. 오방 / 오방자 / 오랑자 / 방랑자 = Oven Wanderer. 치케 = Cheesecake. 딸크 = Strawberry Crepe. 브시 / 시커 = Brightseeker. 들개 = Nameless Cake Hound. 체콜 = Cherry Cola. 쿨민 = Cool Mint. 넝쿨 / 포도 = Grapevine. 에소 = Espresso. 밀키 / 밀웨 = Milky Way. 도넛 / 도넛킹 = Space Doughnut's Royal Excellence (도넛행성 에일리언 도넛킹). 법사 = Wizard.

arena.launched: 2026-07-30 with the game (KR and global launch). Season 1 was running on 2026-08-03 (notice 7982).
arena.format: Asynchronous auto-battle: your attack team vs another player's saved defense team (방어팀/공격팀 set separately). 12 cookies + 3 pets per side. Timer ~60 s counting down (40.300 and 18.967 seen on screen); near the end the game announces '종료 임박 피해량이 더 증가합니다!' (damage increases near the end). Win/loss gives points (+15 to +19 per win seen; a failed defense costs about 1-3 points per guide 43444). Speed x0.5/x1/x1.5/x2 and skip. Continuous-challenge mode (연속 도전) added 2026-09-10.
arena.team_size: 12 cookies + 3 pets; captain (단장) and mercenary perks (용병단 복지) apply (tested by 밀크흑당버블티 23817; confirmed in several guides).
arena.rounds: Single battle per attack; no rounds.
arena.bans_picks: None. Opponent list from a pool; refreshing the list can cost crystals (warning pop-up added 2026-08-13).
arena.timers: ~60 s battle; late-battle damage ramp. Tickets refill at 00:00 KST; arena is locked about 1 h before patch maintenance (guide 43444).
arena.matchmaking: Per server (not cross-server); rankings are per server. Opponent choice by the attacker from a list; guides advise picking opponents with clearly lower power or with stage-preset gear on defense.
arena.seasons: Short seasons (~2 weeks): Season 2 visible 2026-08-22/24, Season 3 ended ~2026-09-09/10, Season 4 mid-September, Season 5 running 2026-09-25/27 (EggZaMonkey, Samool frames). Season end at 12:00 KST per 28949 ('12시 마감'). From Season 3: Champion 1/2/3 tiers for ranks 1-3; Master 4 to Grand Master 1 promotion switched from top-% to absolute rank N (patch 2026-08-27). Champion 2 promotion condition seen as 3,200 points and overall 1st.
arena.rewards: Win gives 명성 (Fame) points (not on loss) that level Fame stats: Boss DMG, Element DMG, Crit DMG (+74-76% at Fame Lv.112 in Noorimer's video). Victory medals (승리의 메달) for the 승리의 메달 교환소. Season-end rewards by rank (Noorimer S3 2nd: 50,000 crystals + 5,000 medals) and a Champion-2 crystal bonus (6,000 shown). Top-1 profile frame.
arena.pvp_modifiers: Applies only: cookie base stats, level, stars/promotion, collection (도감), gear, sugar runes, pets, captain and perks. Does NOT apply: 돌파력 (Breakthrough), Stellar Link, Gnome Lab, Guild Lab (guides 23817, 43444; 33130 lists applied/not applied). So displayed Power (투력) overstates PvP strength ('뻥투력'). Bug: in Season 1 the defense team's DMG Reduction was not applied (attack-side DR worked); fixed from Season 2 (official notice 7982, 2026-08-03). Bug fixed 2026-08-27: defense cookies' starting positions were partly randomised instead of following the saved formation. Official warning 2026-09-23 against pre-arranged win trading in arena (notice 45322). No official power-gap correction (전투력 보정) for PvP was found in any notice or patch note.

rumble_arena.launched: 2026-09-23 (KR/global update 1.4.002; patch note 44477 '신규 콘텐츠 - 와글와글 아레나'). Official EN teaser 'Rumble Arena' published 2026-09-21 (R93baYH9Mf8); TW 熱鬧開戰競技場 teaser same day.
rumble_arena.format: Same auto-battle as Arena (attack team vs saved defense team, 방어 기록 / 도전하러 가기), but cross-server: 'Fight against Mercenary squads from all servers' ('모든 서버의 쿠키들과 만날 수 있습니다!'). 12 cookies + 3 pets; defense and attack team set separately (both 41.59M in the official GIF). Battle timer ~57 s at start in footage.
rumble_arena.timers: ~60 s battle (57.133 → countdown in Seo Sinwoo's footage). Separate Rumble tickets (와글와글 아레나 입장권); tickets can also be bought with mileage (Seo Sinwoo 34A6OeOj3Bo); a display bug for max ticket count was acknowledged 2026-09-23 (notice 45166).
rumble_arena.matchmaking: Cross-server pool; ranking is global. Top-3 podium in the official GIF shows server tags S0001.
rumble_arena.seasons: Irregular season schedule ('비정기적인 시즌제'). Each season has its own passive buff ('시즌마다 정해진 와글와글 아레나 전용 패시브'). Season 1 buff (official GIF frame and Samool EN frame 'Rumble Buff'): Charge (돌격형) cookies max HP +30%; all cookies and summons DMG Reduction +30%. The GIF shows 5d22h left in season; the coordinator's 09-23 → 10-08 dates were not confirmed in the official text I read.
rumble_arena.rewards: 와글와글 메달 (Rumble medals) for a dedicated shop (Rumble Arena Shop in Samool's EN client). Season ranking (official GIF): 1st 3,200 pts → 60,000 crystals + 25,000 medals; 2nd 50,000 + 25,000; 3rd 45,000 + 25,000; top 10 (3,000 pts) 40,000 + 25,000; top 30 35,000 + 25,000; top 100 30,000 + 25,000; Master league (2,000 pts) top 5% 25,000 + 20,000; top 10% 24,000 + 20,000; top 20% 23,000 + 15,000; top 30% 22,000 + 15,000 (list continues). Daily ranking (mailed 00:00 KST): top 100 2,500 medals; Master top 5-30% 2,000 medals. Limited: 'Elite Master tier' profile image for holding Elite Master or above at season end, and a tier-achievement wappen (크럼블 와펜). Limited 와글와글 스페셜 패스 and '격돌! 와글와글 아레나' event launched alongside.
rumble_arena.pvp_modifiers: Season passive above (Charge max HP +30%, all DR +30%). Presumably the same applied-stat rules as Arena (no official statement found; Seo Sinwoo answered that perks likely apply, 45429 comments). The +30% DR is cited by KR guides as the reason pure charge/dive (돌진) comps underperform there and why sustain decks gain value (올렐레오로리 blog 224421116786).

posts.summary_en: Official patch note (captured in record 001). Adds TSSR Princess Bari (fire Charge; dashes at the highest-ATK enemy; souls give self and Charge allies DMG reduction plus lift/push immunity), SSR Moon Rabbit (grass Tank; ATK and CRIT% down on nearby enemies), SSR pet 색동주머니 (ally Lift RES and max HP), and the new cross-server 와글와글 아레나 with irregular seasons and a per-season passive. Also adds the Skill Ready stat and gives Skating Queen, Onion, Cocoa, Poison Mushroom +25% and Oven Wanderer, Cream Soda, Ion, Orange, Rockstar, Strawberry Shortcake +50%.
mechanics: 스킬준비 (Skill Ready): cuts time to the FIRST skill cast by %; computed on the haste-reduced cycle. Cookies already casting at battle start show 100%: Licorice, Pomegranate, Macaron, Cheesecake, Tiger Lily, Nameless Cake Hound, Adventurer, Brightseeker, Pinot Noir, Tea Knight.
Equipment presets can now be changed while oven gear is pulled; auto-open can pick up to 5 substats.
rules: 와글와글 아레나: all servers, irregular seasons, per-season passive, 와글와글 메달 shop.

quotes.kr: 모든 서버의 용병단들과 대결할 수 있는 새로운 경쟁 콘텐츠 '와글와글 아레나'가 오픈됩니다!
quotes.en: Rumble Arena, a new competitive mode where you face Mercenary squads from all servers, opens!

quotes.kr: 시즌마다 정해진 와글와글 아레나 전용 패시브가 적용됩니다.

mechanics: Season 1 defense teams had no DMG Reduction; attack teams did. Fixed from Season 2.

quotes.kr: 아레나 콘텐츠 내 방어팀으로 설정된 쿠키들의 피해 감소 능력이 전투 내에서 적용되지 않는 현상
quotes.en: Cookies set as the arena defense team do not get their DMG Reduction applied in battle.

posts.summary_en: Official notice: accounts that repeatedly pre-arranged arena wins/losses to farm currency and EXP got a first warning by mail; repeat offenders face suspension.
rules: Win trading in arena is a policy violation.

posts.summary_en: Patch note (record 001 capture). Arena tier rework from Season 3: Champion 1-3 tiers for ranks 1-3; Master 4 to Grand Master 1 now promote by absolute rank instead of top-%. Pet ownership effects added to arena help. Defense-team start positions no longer partly random. Stronger buff/debuff of the same stat now correctly takes priority.
mechanics: Before 2026-08-27, defense cookies sometimes started in random positions instead of the saved formation.
Same-stat buffs/debuffs: the stronger one now wins (was bugged).

posts.summary_en: Arena battle now resumes after a force-quit; warning pop-up when refreshing opponents costs crystals.
rules: Refreshing the opponent list can cost crystals.

posts.summary_en: Adds arena continuous challenge (auto-spends all tickets) and keeps scroll position in defense history.

posts.title_kr: 아레나 & 와글와글 아레나 덱 및 세팅 가이드
posts.title_en: Arena & Rumble Arena decks and settings guide
posts.summary_en: Most-liked (223 likes) compilation guide, citing 신비한쿠키사전, a F2P arena post and Seo Sinwoo. Three decks by Princess Bari stars: Bari 7-8★ charge deck; Bari 3-4★ deck with 3 tanks for Armor Repair; Rye deck when Bari is 1-2★ (beats a half-built Bari 5★ deck if Rye is ~8★). Gear rule: skill haste ×6 mandatory, then Skill AMP / crit / DR / crit resist. The author says a Bari deck loses to tank-and-healer stall comps (like the Rye deck) at equal spec.

teams.name: Bari 7-8★ charge deck (from 신비한쿠키사전)

cookies.note: must be highest ATK for Passion Pay

cookies.en: Moon Rabbit Cookie's Pampered with Persimmon

teams.perks: Merc Lv4: 열정페이 + 초고속승진; Lv3: 초고속승진 or all-cookie ATK/DEF/HP +2%. Captain 우유.
teams.formation: Top: Macaron, Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb. Bottom: Oven Wanderer, Cheesecake, Bari, Cake Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit. Power 14.49M. Same screenshot as 45502 (preset named 'PVP 전용').
teams.why: Bari at 5★ grants two Charge allies (Cherry Cola, Oven Wanderer) DMG reduction and lift/push immunity; charge trio collapses the enemy early to win on numbers.
unorthodox: Three charge DPS in an arena otherwise dominated by ranged shooters.

teams.name: Bari 3-4★ deck
teams.perks: 열정페이 + 방어구 수리 특약 (needs 3 Tank cookies: Ion or Schwarzwälder as the third)
teams.formation: Screenshot 45718-2 = Seo Sinwoo's 18.68M deck (see yt _D4EvaRYdJY post). At Bari 5★ add a second charge cookie (Cherry Cola or Oven Wanderer). Swap Cheesecake for Herb for steadier healing; use Brightseeker only at 5★+.
teams.why: Armor Repair (+10% DR with 3 tanks) keeps the low-star Bari alive.

teams.name: F2P Rye deck (Bari 1-2★)
teams.formation: Screenshot 45718-3 (Rye 8★). If Brightseeker is 5★ put it in Grapevine's slot and swap Skating Queen for Doughnut; otherwise Espresso can replace Grapevine.
teams.why: Many tanks and healers with Rye as the lone DPS; survives Bari's opening burst.

counters.beaten_by: tank + healer stall deck with a single Rye DPS (호밀덱)
counters.why: Bari's value is early burst to gain numbers; stall comps absorb it.
counters.conditions: Similar spec; a large spec gap overrides.

builds.gear: Priority 1: Skill AMP, Skill Haste. 2: CRIT%, DMG reduction, CRIT resist. 3: CRIT DMG. One Accuracy line helps. Skill Haste on 6 pieces is mandatory; rest Skill AMP/crit (offense) or DR/crit resist (survival). Left top (weapons): Skill AMP, CRIT% best, CRIT DMG fine, 1 Accuracy. Left bottom: DR, crit resist. Right top: Skill AMP + Skill Haste. Right bottom: Skill Haste + crit resist or DR. Guild Conquest instead: Skill AMP, DR, HP, Haste.

mechanics: Bari 5★ extends the soul buff to 2 Charge allies (DMG and DR buff).
Armor Repair perk requires 3 Tank-role cookies.

results.note: Commenter: wins up to 2x power gap.

disagreements: Commenter 3363: DR+HP vs DR+crit resist on armor gave similar win rates; author says matchup matters more than gear lines.

quotes.kr: 바리는 기본적으로 초반에 상대를 빠르게 정리하면서 수적 우위를 가져가는 것이 중요한 딜러라
quotes.en: Bari is a damage dealer whose job is to clean up opponents early and gain a numbers advantage.

quotes.kr: 와글와글 아레나는 30% 버프 받았으니 괜찮을거 같지만
quotes.en: Rumble Arena gives the 30% buff, so a 2★ Bari is probably fine there.

posts.summary_en: 신비한쿠키사전 (last Arena season 13th; 16th on an earlier S2 board) posts the Oven Wanderer + Bari charge deck (same screenshot as 45718-1). Warns: in Rumble Arena only use it with enough spec or as a heavy spender, otherwise even Rapid Fire (연타) decks beat it. Damage charts show Bari, Oven Wanderer and Cherry Cola all dealing high damage; Oven Wanderer sometimes out-damages Bari after two buffs.

teams.name: 오방바공 charge deck
teams.perks: Lv4 열정페이 + 초고속승진; Lv3 초고속승진 or ATK/DEF/HP +2%. Captain 우유.
teams.why: Bari 5★ souls on Cherry Cola and Oven Wanderer.

counters.team: Bari/Oven Wanderer deck at mediocre spec
counters.why: Rumble +30% DR blunts the charge burst.

builds.gear: Crit resist / DR / RES (저항) for defense, mixed with Skill Haste and Skill AMP. RES matters more this season because Moon Rabbit's skill is a debuff and RES lowers the chance to receive it.

mechanics: Brightseeker does not synergise with the charge deck (use Rapid Fire deck instead if you want Brightseeker).

posts.summary_en: 신비한쿠키사전's three pre-Bari arena decks, all with captain Milk and perks 의료지원(의료보험) + all-cookie ATK/DEF/HP 2%. Deck 1 used most for climbing, deck 2 for opponents deck 1 cannot break, deck 3 a Cherry Cola Rapid Fire deck: Ion included because Pinot Noir heal-reduction starves Milk/Cheesecake healing; Cherry Cola dives with Strawberry Crepe as first damage and the rest follow up, 'one-shot deck', loses if it cannot break fast.
mechanics: Brightseeker 5★ raises drones to 3 (comment).

posts.title_kr: 성능 종결 아레나덱, 아레나 세팅 (와레나덱, 와레나 세팅)
posts.title_en: End-game arena deck and settings (also for Rumble)
posts.summary_en: 꿀빵 (22 server arena 2nd earlier) posts a heal-tank deck he says the arena 1st and 2nd use, winning at 2-5M power deficits. Full sugar-rune and gear plan included.

teams.name: 꿀빵 heal-tank deck

cookies.note: replaced Wind Archer ('damage too erratic at 8★')

cookies.role: crit DMG buffer, 2nd in ATK order

teams.perks: 방어구 수리 특약 (DR) + 열정페이; captain 우유
teams.why: Sustain + heal-reduction + crit buffs; out-sustains burst decks. ATK order Milk > Skating Queen > Macaron (lower other cookies' levels to hold it).
unorthodox: Deliberate level lowering (Ion, Crepe high-80s; Rye, Herb mid-90s) to keep the ATK order for Milk/Pomegranate buffs.

builds.why: Passion Pay and captain on highest ATK.

builds.gear: Right-side 6 pieces: take Skill Haste on each. All 6 bottom pieces: crit resist, DR, Haste only. Top 6: Skill AMP, CRIT%, CRIT DMG, Haste (Skill AMP > CRIT%/DMG). Uses a separate gear preset from Guild Conquest.

mechanics: Brightseeker below 5★ is unusable in arena; high-star Brightseeker is good.

results.usage: Author claims arena #1 and #2 use it

disagreements: Commenter asks whether Doughnut King is 'arena tier 1' — deck omits it.

posts.title_kr: 수정) 바리공주, 달토끼 활용한 신규 아레나 덱 추천 / 와글와글 아레나 추천덱
posts.title_en: New arena deck with Bari and Moon Rabbit / Rumble recommendation
posts.summary_en: 올렐레오로리 (blog tunphoto0224) builds a dive (돌진) deck: charge DPS Cherry Cola, Cool Mint, Oven Wanderer, Bari; Moon Rabbit, Cake Hound, Ion cover; Macaron and Pomegranate buff; Pinot Noir heal-cut; Brightseeker finishes. In Rumble Arena the +30% DR 'is too influential' so dive tests failed and he posts a separate Rumble deck (perks 열정페이 + 가족 같은 용병단). Later final arena deck: Macaron/Pinot/Figure/Milk/Ion/Herb/Rye/Pomegranate/Bari/Hound/Cherry Cola/Moon Rabbit (dropped Oven Wanderer for Skating Queen). Warns it matches badly vs Strawberry Crepe when Bari < 5★.

teams.name: 올렐레 final Bari arena deck
pets: 얼음과자새 (no 초코왕방울; says 왕방울 is better if owned)
teams.perks: 열정페이 + 방어구 수리 특약; captain 우유
teams.why: Charge allies get Bari's DR and lift/push immunity; Moon Rabbit ATK/CRIT down.

builds.sugar_runes: ATK% only up to below Milk; otherwise Skill AMP / Haste. Ion & Hound DR/HP; Pinot Focus/Haste.
builds.why: Durability comes from Bari/perk buffs, so maximise damage.

mechanics: Bari's soul buff covers 1 Charge ally, 2 from 5★.
Cool Mint leaving the fight first drops the win rate.
rules: Rumble Arena: +30% DR 'too influential' for dive decks (blog).
disagreements: Commenter: Doughnut is better than Cool Mint.

quotes.kr: 와글와글 아레나의 경우 ... 쿠키 피해감소 30% 붙어있는게 너무 영향이 커서 잘 안되더라구
quotes.en: In Rumble Arena the 30% cookie DMG reduction matters so much that the dive deck didn't work.

posts.summary_en: Seo Sinwoo cross-post of his YouTube Bari deck (see _D4EvaRYdJY). Says merc perks apply in arena and likely Rumble too.
rules: Merc perks (용병단) apply in arena per player reports.

posts.title_kr: 지루한 진영전이 아쉬운 당신을 위한 아레나 덱
posts.title_en: Arena deck for those bored of formation fights
posts.summary_en: Dive deck: Oven Wanderer with Bari's buff and Chain synergy dives, Cherry Cola with Dragon's Tail (용검), Cool Mint also dives and gets Volley, Macaron for Range synergy so the Hound's skill spreads, Brightseeker as insurance/main DPS, Skating Queen gives Chain to Oven Wanderer and splits aggro, last slot Ion (testing; commenters say Moon Rabbit is very good there). Pets: two 'core' pets fixed plus one matching Rapid Fire / Chain / Range by stars.
mechanics: Oven Wanderer's aggro is strong enough that enemies wander even with Pinot Noir and the new pet.

posts.title_en: Underdog Wizard Rapid Fire arena deck
posts.summary_en: 낑깡: Rapid Fire deck using SR-grade Wizard Cookie. ~100 matches: wins most fights at small power gaps if it survives the opening; catastrophic vs Bari 5★ + Oven Wanderer, so not recommended on defense. Damage: Wizard > Rye = Strawberry Crepe.

teams.name: Wizard Rapid Fire deck

cookies.note: Skill AMP, CRIT DMG, CRIT%; can swap for Ion

teams.perks: 방어구 수리 특약 + 의료보험 (surviving the first turn is key)
teams.why: Rapid Fire synergy with Chargemellow; survive opener then out-damage.
unorthodox: SR Wizard Cookie as top DPS.

counters.why: charge burst kills before it stabilises

builds.gear: Left: Accuracy 1, CRIT%+CRIT DMG 2, Skill AMP 3, DR 3, HP+crit-resist 3. Right: Skill AMP 3, Skill Haste 6, DR 3.

results.win_rate: most wins at small power gaps (~100 games)

posts.summary_en: 5.79M account; Macaron, Rye, Pomegranate, Milk, Strawberry Crepe, Herb / Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Bari, Ion, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit; pets 갓방울 19, 핫도그 18, 얼음과자새 17; perks 의료보험 + 방어구 수리 특약; defense wins vs higher power, especially vs Rapid Fire decks.
disagreements: Brightseeker's high damage alone does not win (author vs commenter).

posts.title_en: Arena Rye deck without high rarities (Seo Sinwoo)
posts.summary_en: Cross-post of YouTube 8k0-Yvtlqx8 (see yt entry).

posts.title_kr: 방어와 변수 메타, 새로운 아레나 덱 추천
posts.summary_en: Pre-Bari: server meta split into a defense meta (tank cookies, esp. Ion) and a variance meta (Doughnut King, Adventurer, Espresso CC). His deck mixes both: Ion + Doughnut King, main DPS Wind Archer, Rye, Brightseeker, with Milky Way instead of Espresso (Milky scatters, Doughnut's CC is better on spread enemies). At 7.87M defended vs higher power. Perks 열정페이 + 종합복지/의료보험; Icy Birdie mandatory on both attack and defense or the team gets one-shot.
mechanics: Espresso pulls enemies together (good for Wind Archer/Rye+Brightseeker centre break); Milky Way knocks back and scatters.

posts.title_en: Arena attack/defense deck after Pinot Noir & Brightseeker
posts.summary_en: After 8/27: Pinot Noir applies crit/heal reduction and Brightseeker breaks the centre; Milky Way and Grapevine dropped; Espresso, Wind Archer, Rye kept. Claims the higher-power side wins almost without variance; beat 1.1M deficit. Captain Rye or Wind Archer suggested (pre-Milk-captain era).
mechanics: 'The healing meta ended' with Pinot Noir heal reduction.
disagreements: Commenters: Espresso often trolls; Milky Way instead.

posts.summary_en: Key finding: whoever casts skills first nearly always wins ('상대방 스킬 먼저 발동 > 거의 필패'), so arena gear = Skill Haste first, then crit resist/RES/Skill AMP/DR on right-side pieces; left side ATK%/CRIT%/CRIT DMG/DR/HP. Pinot Noir's heal reduction beats heal-heavy decks even at a power deficit; with Pinot, two healers suffice. S2 board screenshot shows top-3 with 20★ pets.

builds.gear: Right 6: Skill Haste, Skill AMP, DR, crit resist, RES. Left: ATK%, CRIT%, CRIT DMG, DR, HP.

mechanics: Accuracy/Focus stage gear loses arena fights; skill haste decides who casts first.
disagreements: Commenter: don't rebuild for arena before finishing stages.

quotes.en: Opponent casts first → almost certain loss.

posts.summary_en: Arena applies only base stats + level + stars + gear + collection + sugar runes; not breakthrough, Stellar, gnome or guild lab (captain and perks DO apply, tested). Skill Haste is decisive because CC landing on a cookie as its cooldown ends delays the cast; with haste 10 vs 0 your Space Doughnut polymorphs theirs first and can catch Herb/Milk casts inside the polymorph. Warns of 'inflated power' (뻥투력): over-invested Accuracy/Focus/crit resist, no haste.

builds.gear: Skill Haste / Skill AMP / DR (opponent-independent); Accuracy/Focus/crit resist on only 1-2 pieces.

mechanics: A skill interrupted by CC counts as cast; cooldown restarts.
Space Doughnut polymorph cooldown 6.25 s.
Gear main stats give equal crit-resist/crit, accuracy/evasion, focus/RES per level.
rules: Arena ignores breakthrough, Stellar Link, Gnome Lab, Guild Lab.

posts.summary_en: Arena excludes Stellar, merc squad(?), gnome and guild labs (this guide lists 용병단 as excluded, contradicting tests). Wins give Fame points (boss/element/crit DMG); no points on loss, so some set a weak defense and strong attack since a failed defense only costs 1-3 points. Arena locked ~1 h before patches; tickets refill at midnight; rankings per server. Per-cookie arena sugar-rune list and a Rumble shop section.

builds.sugar_runes: Bari: Skill AMP, Haste, DR. Cherry Cola: Skill AMP, CRIT DMG, DR, ATK%. Cool Mint: Accuracy, Skill AMP, ATK%, DR. Oven Wanderer: Skill AMP, ATK%, DR/HP. Skating Queen: Skill AMP, Haste. Moon Rabbit: Haste, Focus, DR. Strawberry Crepe: DR, ATK%, HP. Ion: Haste, HP, DR, ATK%. Cake Hound: Haste, HP/DR/RES. Pinot Noir: HP / Focus, Haste, DR, ATK%. Herb: Skill AMP, Haste, DR. Macaron: Skill AMP, ATK%. Brightseeker: Skill AMP, Haste, CRIT DMG, ATK%. Wind Archer / Rye / Espresso: Skill AMP, CRIT DMG, ATK%.

mechanics: Milk's ATK rank counts pet, perk and captain ATK% too.
rules: Arena rankings are per server; guilds cross-server.
disagreements: Lists 용병단 as not applied in arena; 23817 and others tested that perks apply.

posts.summary_en: Arena applies cookie level, promotion, collection, gear, sugar runes; power gaps can still lose 100:0 because of gear/rune differences. Every mode has its own gear preset slot.

mechanics: Skill AMP scales every buff and debuff.
CC mid-cast still triggers cooldown.

posts.summary_en: Earlier 꿀빵 deck; perks DR + 열정페이; Milk must be highest ATK; Brightseeker → Espresso if low stars. Cheesecake's ATK buff to Milk raises Milk's heal/buff. Gear: 4 of 6 left pieces with Haste; totals Haste 17, Skill AMP ~32.
disagreements: Milky Way has no CC and poor kills (author) vs others using it.

Rye must survive the first hit; even if Rye and Bari trade, it can win. Wins at 15.99M vs 16.8M and 16.65M (rank to 8th). PonPonLin (TW, 09-24): separate Rumble and regular arena configs, 'Bari basically must be 5★'. Samool Moon Rabbit review: commenters run full DR runes on Moon Rabbit.
